Calculation mismatch in medication margins and annual totals led to failed assertions in the legacy test suite.
The test_rows_and_order failed with 'close(55944.0, 3996.0)' returning False, indicating a significant discrepancy in medication-level calculations. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because the calculated annual margin of -440348.83 did not match the expected -42908.83. These errors occurred within /tests/test_outputs.py during the subprocess call from test_output.py. Avoid assuming the current margin logic is correct; re-verify the formulas for 28-day vs 56-day supply cost-benefit transitions.
